faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild engines for all Range Rover models?
faqLeft.a: Yes - we rebuild and replace engines across every Range Rover generation, from the P38A up to the current L460.

faqLeft.q: Do I keep my original engine, or do you send me a different one?
faqLeft.a: We rebuild the engine your Range Rover already has wherever possible, avoiding the compatibility risks that come with fitting a used engine of unknown history.
Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqLeft.q: What warranty comes with a rebuild?
faqLeft.a: Every rebuild comes with a 12 month unlimited-mileage warranty.

faqRight.a: We collect your car nationwide from £70. Most vehicles are recovered within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: How much does a Range Rover engine rebuild cost?
faqRight.a: 6-cylinder diesel rebuilds start from £2,400, V8 diesel and petrol from £4,500, and supercharged V8 (SVAutobiography) from £5,500. Exact price depends on engine code and condition - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqRight.q: Does the TDV6/SDV6 timing chain issue affect every Range Rover?
faqRight.a: Not every vehicle, but it's a well-documented pattern on this engine family - we replace timing chains, tensioners and injector seals as standard on every TDV6/SDV6 rebuild where worn or damaged. If your Range Rover also shows air suspension warning signs, that's a separate system from the engine and outside our rebuild service, but worth flagging to whoever handles that side of things.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
